chapter_title: Political Intrigue: Cardinal Harms and Procurator Bulkowsky

narrative_observations: This chapter introduces the political opposition to Emmanuel's birthâ€”not merely demonic but institutional. Bulkowsky's superiority in actual power (while appearing weak) foreshadows that divine intervention will transcend all human political structures. The parallel plots of both leaders seeking to eliminate the child establish the novel's apocalyptic stakes. Big Noodle's role as omniscient but amoral suggests technology as a tool of either side.
